text: Jantano ɓe -an Nulaaɗo- Ñalnde Darngal tuma nde Alla Daalanta ɓen sirkannooɓe Mo ka aduna: "Noddee kafidaaɓe An ɓen, ɓen ɓe aaƴinoɗon wonnde kamɓe ko ɓe kafidaaɓe An bela-jo'o kamɓe ɓe wallay on, ɓe nodda ɓe ɓe noototaako noddaandu maɓɓe ndun ɓe wallataaɓe, Men waɗa hakkunde rewooɓe ɓen e rewaaɓe ɓen halkorde nde ɓe kafi e mun, ɗun ko Yiite Jahannama.
